title: P0A1F - P0A1F
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Sensör okuma hatası veya tesisat temassızlığı
stepByStepSolution: 1. VCDS / ODIS ile canlı veri grupları taranır.
2. Tesisat ve voltaj beslemeleri test edilir.
3. Gerekirse OEM yedek parça ile yenilenip adaptör sürüşü yapılır.
technicalNotes:
When P0A1F 00 - Battery Energy Kontrol Modülü is stored in the Bentayga with W12 engine using the Super capacitor type of Address 61: Battery Regul. (J1120) see NAR market TPI 2051553.
NHTSA https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2018/MC-10145085-9999.pdf
The capacitor system can be identified in the VCDS can based on Component: BMS_48V_SCAP
Additional DTCs covered by that TPI include: P0A9E, P0AC8 and P0ECA with various 48V chassis control issues in Address D4-Roll Control 1 and Address D5-Roll Control 2.
